She reaches for the door handle and pulls it open to enter the establishment, which is warmly lit. (2) Following the woman inside, the camera captures a glimpse of a service counter where a staff member wearing a face mask and a blue uniform is working behind a wooden partition. The interior features warm wooden accents, soft lighting, and shelves stocked with coffee cups and saucers. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up pan across a magazine rack located inside the cafe. Various Japanese magazines are displayed, featuring models on the covers and Japanese text. The camera focuses on a specific magazine featuring a model in a bikini, emphasizing a curiosity-driven visual detail for the viewer.
